items.title: The Problem With Colorful Houses
items.why: An architecture professor traces how American houses went beige, gray and black, starting with San Francisco's Painted Ladies and running through lead paint and public-health history.

items.title: The disappearing and unappreciated art of audible alerts
items.why: Beeps, chimes and alarm tones treated as interface design. It's feedback you hear rather than read, and it builds on his earlier video about elevator chimes.

items.title: The secret history of font piracy
items.why: A designer and type historian looks at how fonts get copied and resold. One example is the famous anti-DVD-piracy PSA, which itself used a pirated font.

items.title: Small Apartment Transformed With Clever Storage and Colour
items.why: A 58 m² (624 sq ft) apartment in Wrocław, Poland, by interior designer Karolina Jackowska of the studio Onuko.

items.title: In Praise of Brilliant Voiceover
items.why: Screenwriting advice usually warns against voiceover. This essay argues for the films that make it work.

items.title: Cormac McCarthy's Most Profound Story
items.why: A close reading of the heretic-and-priest tale inside McCarthy's novel The Crossing, a story the creator says he spent two years untangling.

items.title: Why Does Everyone Think “1984” Agrees With Them?
items.why: A long essay on how Orwell's novel gets claimed by every side of an argument.

items.title: Why Did Terminator 2 Look Like That?
items.why: From the channel behind your Star Trek pick. It asks whether T2's blue nights were a choice by James Cameron's crew or how night was shot back then.

items.title: Did the Romans Know their Empire was Declining?
items.why: How Romans living through the collapse described what was happening to them, drawn from ancient sources.

items.title: Eat Like A Medieval Hermit
items.why: A historical recipe cooked on camera, alongside the history of the people who ate it.

items.title: I Built a REAL Woodworking Vise for Almost Nothing
items.why: A face vise built from a vise screw and hardware-store pipe fittings. Free plans are linked in the description.

items.title: Is It Okay To Steal Ideas?
items.why: A designer-maker on copying, influence and credit in maker work.

items.title: Sungazer Plus Live at the Blue Note (full concert)
items.why: A full big-band concert film recorded July 1–2, 2025, at the Blue Note in New York. It's the long-form live set, in the spirit of your Vulfpeck pick.

items.title: Brìghde Chaimbeul: Tiny Desk Concert
items.why: Scottish smallpipes, played in a folk tradition and pushed somewhere new.

items.title: I Built a Real Version of a Plugin
items.why: A software drone instrument rebuilt as physical hardware. It sits next to your David Hilowitz FM-1 pick.
